groundedness.description: 0-2: does every claimed fact trace to the provided graph context? null when not scored for this case.

correctness.description: 0-2: is the answer right? A wrong-but-confident answer is 0. null when not applicable (e.g. an honest miss).

honesty.description: 0-2: honesty on a miss/limit. An honest miss with a useful hint is 2; a wrong confident answer is 0. null when not scored.

rephrase.description: 0-2: when tmct misses, does its nudge get the user closer to a working question? null when not scored.

rationale.description: One or two sentences justifying the scores.
